This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code). MVP demo: full-stack budget tracker. Prefer simple, readable, composable code and clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead.

Backend: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal Web API/EF Core in `src/BudgetTracker.Api/`; feature folders `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`; Identity cookies + Static API keys. Frontend: React 18/TypeScript strict/Vite/Tailwind, React Router v7, Axios, auth, anti-forgery, multi-tenancy/user isolation, CSV import, AI categorization/recommendations, semantic vector search. Docker Compose local development.

dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down

Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest). Test naming follows snake_case convention: `Should_do_when_something`. Integration tests use Testcontainers for isolated database testing. Mocking with NSubstitute preferred. User isolation enforced at database query level. API keys configured via `StaticApiKeysConfiguration` section. Anti-forgery protection with conditional filtering. Azure OpenAI, pgvector embeddings, background AI recommendations, NLP query assistance. .NET 10 nullable reference types enabled.

PostgreSQL: `Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`
API: http://localhost:5295; frontend: http://localhost:5173; Swagger: http://localhost:5295/swagger. CORS supports ports 5295/5173. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
